decks.notes: The deck focuses on using the combo of Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. It includes various cards to search for combo pieces, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and control the board. Liliana of the Veil provides additional disruption, while Raffine's Informant helps to dig for combo pieces. The deck also includes removal and protection spells to help the combo go off smoothly. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo quickly and efficiently to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using low-cost spirits to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom to pump up your spirits, as well as disruptive counterspells like Spell Queller and Lofty Denial, you can keep your opponent on the back foot while continuing to chip away at their life total. Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr provides a powerful anthem effect for your spirits, while cards like Curious Obsession and Invasion of Gobakhan can help you draw cards and maintain momentum in the late game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a flood of small, aggressive creatures known as "weenies." By quickly building a board presence with cards like Hopeful Initiate, Luminarch Aspirant, and Thalia's Lieutenant, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and win the game before the opponent can stabilize. Cards like Brave the Elements and Wedding Announcement help protect your creatures and push through damage, while the mana base allows for consistent plays and the ability to activate Mutavault for additional threats.

The primary focus of this deck is to build up a strong board presence through efficient mana ramping with cards like Llanowar Elves and Old-Growth Troll, while also leveraging devotion to green with cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Polukranos Reborn. The deck aims to flood the board with threats and overwhelm the opponent quickly, utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival to maintain pressure and control the game. The inclusion of cards like Oath of Nissa and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps to ensure consistency and card advantage to keep the tempo high.

The main concept of this deck is to leverage the synergy between Spirits and tempo-based control elements to quickly overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By using efficient creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Shacklegeist alongside disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Lofty Denial, the deck aims to apply pressure while also maintaining board control. The inclusion of cards like Curious Obsession and Supreme Phantom further enhance the deck's ability to close out games quickly and efficiently. Overall, the key strategy revolves around aggressive tempo play and exploiting the tribal synergies of Spirits.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board with counterspells, removal, and board wipes while generating card advantage through draw spells. The addition of Yorion as a companion allows for extra value with flicker effects. The deck aims to disrupt opponent's plays, slow down the game with tempo plays, and eventually win through card advantage and powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The manabase is designed to support the control gameplan with utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Ardenvale.

The main concept of this deck is to flood the board with small, aggressive creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By consistently playing low-cost creatures like Hopeful Initiate and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain a strong presence on the battlefield. Thalia's Lieutenant and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben provide additional support for the weenies, while cards like Brutal Cathar and Ossification help protect them and ensure they can continue to attack. The deck's focus on speed and aggression makes it a formidable opponent in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly generating large amounts of green mana and overwhelming the opponent with powerful green creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven, the deck aims to ramp up mana production early in the game to cast big threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Polukranos Reborn. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to search for key pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a strong emphasis on green devotion, this deck aims to win through aggressive plays and mana advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently ramp into powerful combo pieces using cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II, supported by cards like Satyr Wayfinder and Stitcher's Supplier to enable graveyard recursion. The deck also includes disruption tools like Thoughtseize and Witherbloom Command to control the game and protect the combo. With access to strong removal options and the ability to generate card advantage through cards like Raffine's Informant and Grisly Salvage, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its powerful synergies and versatile gameplay.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with efficient creatures and burn spells, aiming to deal damage as quickly as possible and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with powerful burn spells like Play with Fire and Atarka's Command. With a low mana curve and a high density of threats, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and punish opponents who are unable to keep up with its aggressive tempo.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disrupting your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. It also utilizes removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill to control the board. The deck includes powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to pressure opponents. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Misery's Shadow provide additional threats to overwhelm the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive strategy while also including utility lands like Castle Locthwain for card advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early creature aggression and disruption, aiming to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while controlling the board with removal spells and hand disruption. The deck includes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, as well as efficient removal spells such as Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. By combining creatures with disruptive elements, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize and mount a defense.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays using powerful creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes a combination of creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and Bloodtithe Harvester alongside efficient removal spells such as Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and deal damage quickly. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil to generate card advantage and control the board. The mana base provides a good balance between black and red sources to support the aggressive game plan.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The key strategy is to survive the early game with efficient removal like Make Disappear and Lay Down Arms, then establish control with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also utilizes sweepers like Supreme Verdict and card advantage engines like Memory Deluge to outvalue the opponent. The goal is to grind out the game until you can establish a dominant board presence and outvalue the opponent.
